title: AS2: typeof, instanceof, delete, void operators
description: Verify the AS2 compiler handles typeof (ActionTypeOf 0x44), instanceof (ActionInstanceOf 0x54), delete (ActionDelete 0x3a / ActionDelete2 0x3b), and void operators. Search packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts for these. For any missing: typeof x -> ActionPush x + ActionTypeOf; x instanceof Y -> ActionPush x + ActionPush Y + ActionInstanceOf; delete obj.prop -> ActionPush obj + ActionPush prop + ActionDelete; void x -> compile x + ActionPop + ActionPush undefined. Add tests for each.
